verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents self-service data transfer/audit tools for new customers, bulk import of multiple object types (companies, deals, activities/calls/meetings) with associations, and automatic plus manual deduplication by email/domain/record ID, covering the core migration path of bringing records and history. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of owner-mapping/reassignment during import, preservation of full historical audit trails/timestamps from the source CRM, and independent case-study evidence confirming successful cross-CRM migrations.
